results.title: Politics : RoS Confirms Receiving Bersatu Complaint Over PN Membership
results.description: PUTRAJAYA, Aug 11 (Bernama) -- The Registrar of Societies Malaysia (RoS) has confirmed receiving an official complaint from Parti Pribumi Bersatu Malaysia (Bersatu) over claims that the party was not involved in the Perikatan Nasional (PN) Supreme Council meeting on July 16 and issues related to its membership in the coalition.
